verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile developer tool, so managing remote coding-agent tasks from a phone is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents an in-app conversational Repository Agent that edits, commits and pushes. Nothing shows dispatching, monitoring or tracking cloud-based agent tasks. The in-app agent is an adjacent feature and does not count for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
